cases.name: Renee Patricia Shereyk Isadore
cases.about:
She had the same maiden name as his last name but they were never married. 

She was a registered nurse. Her obituary said, "Renee was also dearly loved by many nieces, nephews, cousins, and countless friends. Graduate of St. Xavier University School of Nursing and a much loved Nurse at Advocate Christ Medical Center."
